changsha-2013.notes: The eleven PTA (pintia.cn) pages are ZOJ problems 3726-3736; none of them names the contest or gives a problem letter, so the attribution to Changsha 2013 rests on the consecutive numbering and the catalogue's count of 11 (only Skycity's story mentions Changsha). The catalogue has no problem names for this contest; these pages give them in ZOJ order.
